content.title: About
content.content: Pudding is a ready‑to‑prepare dry mix that lets you create a smooth dessert without added sugar. It is offered in several non‑chocolate flavours such as vanilla, caramel, berry and coffee. The mix provides protein, fiber and very low carbs, making it a convenient option for diet‑focused eating.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The dry mix is formulated to retain texture and flavour even without sugar.
Non‑chocolate flavours often use natural extracts like vanilla bean, sugar‑free caramel syrup and berry concentrates.
Preparation is simple: just add hot water or milk and stir.
Sugar‑free formulation suits low‑carb, keto and diabetic diets.
The mix has a long shelf life and does not require refrigeration before use.

items.title: Sugar‑free
items.content: No added sugar helps control blood glucose levels and supports energy balance.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: The mix contains plant‑based or dairy proteins that support muscle maintenance.

items.title: Source of fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: It raises blood sugar slowly, beneficial for diabetes management and weight control.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Often fortified with vitamin D, calcium and magnesium for bone and nerve health.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: The product may contain dairy, soy or nut‑derived flavourings; people with relevant allergies should check the label.

items.title: Excessive artificial sweeteners
items.content: Some versions use sugar substitutes that can cause gastrointestinal discomfort in large amounts.

items.title: Not suitable for young children
items.content: The thick texture may be difficult for toddlers; serve diluted if needed.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix the dry powder with hot water, milk or a plant‑based beverage, stir until smooth and let stand for 2–3 minutes. Serve as a standalone dessert or top with fresh berries, nuts or a sugar‑free syrup.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the dry mix in a sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, use within 3–4 months. Prepared pudding should be refrigerated and consumed within 24 hours.
